claims: The Pittsburgh Penguins are the 2nd seed in the Metropolitan Division.
The Philadelphia Flyers are the 3rd seed.
The Pittsburgh Penguins will face the Philadelphia Flyers in the 2026 Eastern Conference First Round.
Game 1 starts on Saturday, April 18, 2026, at 8 p.m. ET at PPG Paints Arena.
The Penguins hold home-ice advantage in the best-of-7 series.
Games 1, 2, 5, and 7 are played in Pittsburgh.
Game 1 of the 2026 NHL Eastern Conference First Round between the Penguins and the Flyers is on Saturday, April 18, 8:00 p.m. ET at Pittsburgh.
Game 1 will be broadcast on ESPN/NBCSP.
Full, official dates for Games 2-7 are pending final NHL release.
